verdict.comment: Irish raider ANDYS FLAME (nap) is well worth supporting on this return from a break as his Cheltenham fifth in October reads well.

comments.andysflame: Early days over fences and his fifth at Cheltenham in October (2m4f, good) reads well
comments.chapelgreen: Below best last twice but on a competitive mark if running to anything like his best form
comments.fetechampetre: Form claims but recently withdrawn on account of good ground which is worrying
comments.flashdupistolet: 9lb higher here in a more competitive race but he's got his tail up
comments.gardedeschamps: Consistent and wasn't done with when falling on his final run at Wetherby in October
comments.golddesbois: Has a good record here but all his best days have been over shorter distances
comments.highmoon: Not the most consistent and he's hard to win with at the best of times
comments.ozzycosmo: Only his third run over fences when not beaten far at Newcastle; had a wind op
comments.restandbethankful: Went close on final chase run here in September and has been hurdling since then

races.raceComment: flashdupistolet is marginally preferred with a score of 56.4%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over highmoon. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include excellent form and strong course form and positive comments, though inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.amberhoney: Yet to build on debut promise but things may well click again on this first handicap start
comments.ardaddy: Has shown ability but he finished last on his recent handicap debut at Newcastle
comments.flamboroughhead: Good third at Newcastle (7f, AW) recently and major player if seeing out this longer trip
comments.groundhog: Hasn't achieved much but the first-time hood could help on this handicap/seasonal debut
comments.hashtagnotions: Two wins at Newcastle from last four starts; strong claims if he's just as good on turf
comments.heartened: Soundly beaten last August/September in her two nurseries and absent since
comments.hillorue: Improvement needed on handicap debut but has lowly mark and potential in pedigree
comments.keatshouse: No threat in either nursery but the first-time hood and step up in trip may be positives
comments.ottoman: 0-7 in Ireland last year but case can be made on best form; watch betting on stable debut
comments.rosezan: Fair fifth on handicap debut (6f, AW) and perhaps the step back up in trip will suit
comments.sanbona: Half-brother to three winners but struggled in nurseries on his last two starts
comments.treblewinners: Well beaten on handicap debut last August and absent since, but has shown promise here

races.raceComment: hashtagnotions is strongly preferred with a score of 40.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form over flamboroughhead. Won 2 of last 5 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for PALLAS LORD, who has been in rude health on the AW of late and won a division of this race in 2022.

comments.ahamoment: Found to be lame when down the field last time; good run previously; possible player
comments.alfieboy: Form went the wrong way last year but this C&D winner is down to a handy mark
comments.havanaprince: Won over C&D last July and this front-runner could bounce back to form with a bold bid
comments.heavenlyheather: Has shown ability on AW; improvement needed on handicap debut but it's possible
comments.highlandolly: Made debut last May; one win from his 12 starts; needs to reappear at the top of his game
comments.idealguest: Struggled on his three runs towards the end of last year, following an absence
comments.pallaslord: In rude health on AW and won a division of this in 2022; respected
comments.quintusarrius: Mark continues to fall but this regressive 5yo needs to halt the slide
comments.roaringralph: C&D winner; some good efforts at Newcastle this year and could be thereabouts
comments.stratocracy: Two wins from final four starts last year; returns minus cheekpieces but not ruled out
comments.swissace: Runner-up at Newcastle in January but hasn't scored on turf since 2020
comments.toralou: Handicap debut; runner-up on two of her three starts and in excellent hands to progress
comments.yorkshireglory: Lightly raced 4yo; fair reappearance at Newcastle; needs to build on it now back on turf

races.raceComment: havanaprince is marginally preferred with a score of 58.7%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form over roaringralph. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The very lightly raced 4yo BAREFOOT WARRIOR (nap) is a highly likeable prospect for David O'Meara and can complete a hat-trick.

comments.austriantheory: Won on penultimate outing last season but over 1m2f
comments.barefootwarrior: 2-3; has potential off his opening mark and he's firmly in calculations
comments.barley: Ran well first time up last term and he's a competitive mark on the pick of his 2024 form
comments.classicencounter: 0-6 and doesn't seem straightforward, but peak RPR came on his sole turf outing
comments.cruyffturn: Might need this reappearance run but he's 3-6 here and is not discounted
comments.empireoflight: Often ran well last season (including over C&D); one to be interested in on return
comments.goodmorningalex: Form dipped last August-October, following prolific spell, but a break may have helped
comments.greatblasket: Runs off last winning mark and reappears with dual-purpose yard among winners on the Flat
comments.haleend: Two wins last season and his reappearance record suggests he could have a part to play
comments.mrking: Close third at Ayr last September and returns having had wind surgery; not ruled out
comments.reidh: Below par at end of last season but has positive reappearance record and is well treated
comments.themepark: Two wins from final five starts last term; improved for his comeback run last season

races.raceComment: greatblasket is marginally preferred with a score of 51.0%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over haleend. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 7/24 at redcar. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.jojorabbit: Has won four of his nine starts over C&D and goes well first time out; needs considering
comments.levelup: Likes it here; been running fairly well but others look stronger in a competitive handicap
comments.phoenixbeach: New 7lb higher mark has kicked in now and he's drawn wide but has a good record over C&D

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight left-handed polytrack

verdict.comment: Bold Suitor is respected but BUNGLE BAY's attitude counts for plenty at this level and he's fancied to notch an eighth course win.

comments.boldsuitor: Will likely be dropped in again from stall 12 and goes on the shortlist upped a fair 2lb
comments.bunglebay: Little margin for error off this mark, but he tries hard and enters the equation
comments.candywarhol: Drawn to attack again but is inconsistent; may not be as lucky this time under a penalty
comments.charlatan: This is just the second time he's run at shy of 1m since handicapping; needs a proper test
comments.diligenthenry: Better upped to this trip last autumn; this mark looks within range if ready to go again
comments.pennysspirit: This is more realistic but would want to see support before considering her
comments.riverwharfe: Closely matched with Bungle Bay on C&D running last month; holds each-way claims
comments.smasher: Goes beyond 6f for the first time; will need to settle better than has often been the case
comments.sochic: This is stronger, off her revised mark back in handicap company, but she's respected
comments.thecolakid: Hit traffic early returned to 6f last time; that's best ignored but others look stronger
comments.tillitshines: Down to earth from stall 11 behind Bold Suitor latest; is some way down the pecking order
comments.yarayah: Made a fair start for his new yard (7f) a fortnight ago but now needs to build on it

races.raceComment: boldsuitor is marginally preferred with a score of 64.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over sochic. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Lhebayeb won here last time but PORT NOIR was a close third in that race and may be able to turn the tables over this longer trip.

comments.bayofnaples: Disappointing at Wolverhampton last time and he will need a good pace back at this trip
comments.bitcoinprofit: Won here (8.6f) last April but she's been disappointing since and is now 1-15
comments.dashpower: Didn't fire at Southwell but he was in good form before that; dangerous back up in trip
comments.exceptionality: 17-race maiden who has yet to finish closer than 6l to the winner; opposable
comments.lhebayeb: Ended a long losing run when making all here latest; up 3lb but she's respected
comments.onlocustpoint: Six-race maiden who has not really progressed and he needs improvement at this new trip
comments.portnoir: Six-time course winner who was a close third here latest; dangerous back up in trip
comments.riveralwen: Won at Chelmsford in November and was a creditable fourth at Lingfield latest; in the mix
comments.seriouslook: Struggled badly in 2024 and has lots to prove after 188 days off
comments.starofjupiter: Lightly raced 4yo; won over C&D in February but was disappointing latest; mixed messages

races.raceComment: portnoir is marginally preferred with a score of 60.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more reliable profile over lhebayeb. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Papa Don't Preach is risky and perhaps STATE OF MADNESS, who hasn't had the breaks in three runs this year, will get off the mark.

comments.alafdhal: Hard to win with but capable off this mark if the new headgear combination does the trick
comments.autumnangel: Two winter C&D wins came off much lower marks and there's little wiggle room
comments.bombsquad: Dual C&D winner who's enjoyed a very consistent spell; no margin for error off this mark
comments.globaleffort: Ahead of better-fancied stablemate Alafdhal over C&D last Monday; holds each-way claims
comments.nubough: Long time since he ran on Tapeta and, unsurprisingly given his age, lacks consistency now
comments.outeredge: Has hung left under pressure several times, so stall 13 can only look a handicap

verdict.comment: The vote goes to HIERONYMUS who has passed the post in front six times here including on his latest outing.

comments.atarangi: Market useful on stable/AW/handicap debut after six months off
comments.atlanticgamble: Record in handicaps after his reappearance last year read 1111311; watch market on return
comments.brasilpower: Three wins over 7f here; would have made more appeal at that trip but still frame material
comments.crackshot: Worth a market check on stable/AW debut after six months off
comments.enthused: Has shown little in three starts since returned to AW last month; best watched for now
comments.hieronymus: Handy sort whose six wins (disqualified once) have all come here; respected
comments.lessay: Record here reads 12221; may be best at 7f but still one to be interested in returned here
comments.nobleorder: Useful but has been hard to train; addition of a hood will need to have a dramatic effect
comments.pjanoo: Makes his debut for a new yard in a first-time tongue-tie; market useful
comments.racingbreaksryder: Didn't run very well in one go on the AW (Tapeta) so something to prove in the conditions
comments.rhythmnrock: 0-19 since winning over C&D as a 4yo; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise
comments.rogueencore: Should be all the better for his return at Doncaster nine days ago; has run well over C&D

races.raceComment: atlanticgamble is marginally preferred with a score of 56.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form over brasilpower. Won 5 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 1 wins from 3 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/11 at kempton. verdict.comment: This can go to AL AMEEN (nap) who did it well when winning over C&D last month. He remains feasibly treated on previous form.

comments.alameen: Won well over C&D last month; up 6lb but still feasibly treated on previous form
comments.arctician: Back off his last winning mark and has to make the shortlist under his optimum conditions
comments.berryclever: Won twice over C&D in October; market useful back from 166 days off
comments.chifa: Ran a blinder after 472 days off when third at Wolverhampton a fortnight ago; respected
comments.futurecutlet: Still unexposed and makes his stable debut after five months off; market useful
comments.hodler: Modest in three AW starts and has no great record fresh; looks one for another day
comments.kingcabo: Both AW wins have come here, but will do well to win this on his first start in six months
comments.lafleurpetrus: 1-5 for Charlie Johnston; makes her stable debut after another 164 days off; market useful
comments.mbappe: Off 138 days, but was returning from a similar absence when winning over C&D a year ago
comments.perennial: Has regressed since making a winning debut at Salisbury last June; hard to recommend
comments.soarabove: Eight wins here, but losing run up to 28; best watched
comments.staceyracey: C&D winner; may have needed her reappearance but others are more compelling
comments.strike: Stable going well, but will need luck from the widest stall; opposed on balance

races.raceComment: berryclever is marginally preferred with a score of 54.9%, holding clear edges in more reliable profile over chifa. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Carbine Harvester is progressive but BROSAY, who came away with him at Lingfield and is 5lb better off, can turn things round.

comments.ardennes: Twice finished comfortably held behind Carbine Harvester; remains vulnerable to improvers
comments.brosay: Ex-Irish; cheekpieces have helped; claims on his close second to Carbine Harvester
comments.carbineharvester: Needs a bit more again upped another 2lb but that's entirely possible; shortlisted
comments.jeweloflondon: Found the ideal opening when last seen; will find this rather more competitive
comments.mauibreeze: May have more to offer now handicapping but needs to improve if she's to overcome stall 12
comments.noblevictory: No excuses from the front in novice company (Tapeta) latest; needs more now handicapping
comments.pontneuf: Won his first two last spring before struggling in decent company; looks exposed now
comments.proudlyyours: May have needed her comeback for new connections but only looks to hold outside claims
comments.santasavana: Highly tried after winning first time out last year; an easy 6f doesn't strike as optimal
comments.tattiebogle: Easier 6f may not be ideal (first two runs came over 7f) from a wide stall on comeback
comments.theflyingseagull: This mark within range but again might have been better drawn for one happiest in front
comments.wheelsoffire: Hung left a couple of times last season; needs to be more professional on comeback

races.raceComment: carbineharvester is confidently preferred with a score of 52.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form and more reliable profile over theflyingseagull. Won 3 of last 4 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 2 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 3/7 at kempton. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: A repeat win in this race is on the cards for CINNODIN who is 4lb lower than when beating Zoran last April.

comments.artisandancer: A 2m winner on Polytrack elsewhere; quite temptingly treated now but off since August
comments.cinnodin: Had few 2m runs on Polytrack; ultimately impressive in this last year; respected
comments.hebrideannomad: Knocking on the door at 1m2f/1m4f; failed to find much over new 1m6f trip latest
comments.robusto: Involved in tight finishes in 3 of his 4 runs this winter; tight with Zoran on C&D form
comments.roguetornado: Has won at 1m4f (turf) and 1m6f (Tapeta); not yet proved he's suited by 2m
comments.zoran: Solid over C&D, beat Robusto in January; lesser Lingfield run since; do better back here

races.raceComment: cinnodin is marginally preferred with a score of 55.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over zoran. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard To Slow) looks ideal with 2 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Nowhere is a player but the vote goes to DIBBLE DABBLE, who made a pleasing comeback three weeks ago.

comments.birthdayangel: Regressive maiden who's found his level; stamina to prove back up from 1m2f however
comments.byebyesalam: Beaten a long way in three runs, including two for Andrew Balding; yard been in great form
comments.dibbledabble: Won second time out last year and has a fair chance of following suit upped 2lb
comments.egoiste: Needs to settle better going beyond 1m2f for the first time but is one to consider
comments.foreseen: Better on his second run for this yard but will want to settle going up in trip again
comments.goldendove: Fair record here but has something to prove for her new yard back from three months off
comments.imperialcult: Behind Foreseen a fortnight ago; may need a bit of help from the handicapper now
comments.laserfocus: Serial slow starter; did better back on turf nine days ago; AW record far from inspiring
comments.nowhere: Maiden who ran two solid races in defeat for her new yard last month; should go well again
comments.solanna: Four-time course winner; only been this far once; little wiggle room off this mark
comments.versatile: Ex-Irish maiden; undergone wind surgery since last seen five months ago; market useful
comments.yessir: Gelded ahead of this handicap debut and is worth tracking in the market
